description: MCP server for Coolify — 64 tools to deploy, diagnose, and manage apps, databases, and services on your self-hosted PaaS. OpenAPI-generated schemas, docs search, secrets masked by default.

tool_signatures.name: applicationEnvs
tool_signatures.description: Manage environment variables for an application. Actions: list (secrets masked unless showSecrets), create, update, upsert (create or update by key), bulk_update (pass envs array), delete (needs env_uuid).

envs.description: For bulk_update: full list of env vars to apply

parameters.name: envs
parameters.description: For bulk_update: full list of env vars to apply

tool_signatures.name: cancelDeployment
tool_signatures.description: Cancel a running deployment by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: controlDatabase
tool_signatures.description: Start, stop, or restart a database by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: createApplication
tool_signatures.description: Create a new application.

extra.description: Additional Coolify application fields for the chosen type

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: Additional Coolify application fields for the chosen type

tool_signatures.name: createDatabase
tool_signatures.description: Create a database.

tool_signatures.name: createEnvironment
tool_signatures.description: Create a new environment in a project. Requires the project UUID.

tool_signatures.name: createPrivateKey
tool_signatures.description: Create a new SSH private key. The private_key field should contain the full PEM-encoded key.

tool_signatures.name: createProject
tool_signatures.description: Create a new Coolify project. Returns the project UUID.

tool_signatures.name: createServer
tool_signatures.description: Create a new server. Requires a private key UUID for SSH access.

tool_signatures.name: createService
tool_signatures.description: Create a one-click service (database, cache, etc.) or a Docker Compose deployment (pass docker_compose_raw with the YAML content). Requires project_uuid, server_uuid, and environment_name (or environment_uuid). Since Coolify v4.1, Docker Compose deployments are services, not applications.

tool_signatures.name: databaseBackups
tool_signatures.description: Manage scheduled backups for a database. Actions: list, create, update, delete (backup schedules), list_executions, delete_execution. create/update take frequency (cron expression) plus optional fields (enabled, save_s3, s3_storage_uuid, databases_to_backup, dump_all, retention settings via extra).

scheduled_backup_uuid.description: Required for update, delete, list_executions, delete_execution

parameters.name: scheduled_backup_uuid
parameters.description: Required for update, delete, list_executions, delete_execution

tool_signatures.name: databaseEnvs
tool_signatures.description: Manage environment variables for a database. Actions: list (secrets masked unless showSecrets), create, update, bulk_update (pass envs array), delete (needs env_uuid).

envs.description: For bulk_update: full list of env vars to apply

parameters.name: envs
parameters.description: For bulk_update: full list of env vars to apply

tool_signatures.name: deleteApplication
tool_signatures.description: Delete an application by UUID. Optionally delete volumes, configurations, and connected networks.

tool_signatures.name: deleteDatabase
tool_signatures.description: Delete a database by UUID. By default Coolify also deletes configurations, volumes, and connected networks and runs docker cleanup; pass the flags as false to keep them.

tool_signatures.name: deleteProject
tool_signatures.description: Delete a project by UUID. This will delete all environments and resources in the project.

tool_signatures.name: deploy
tool_signatures.description: Trigger a deployment for an application by UUID or tag. With wait=true, polls until every triggered deployment reaches a terminal status (finished/failed/cancelled) and returns a log tail for failures — raise your MCP client

wait.description: Poll until the deployment finishes instead of returning immediately

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Poll until the deployment finishes instead of returning immediately

tool_signatures.name: diagnoseApp
tool_signatures.description: Diagnose an application by UUID, name, or domain. Aggregates current status, the latest deployments, a log tail from the most recent failed deployment, recent runtime logs, and suggested next actions in one call.

identifier.description: Application UUID, name, or domain (fqdn substring)

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Application UUID, name, or domain (fqdn substring)

tool_signatures.name: diagnoseServer
tool_signatures.description: Diagnose a server by UUID, name, or IP: lists the resources running on it with a status breakdown, configured domains, and suggested next actions.

tool_signatures.name: getApplication
tool_signatures.description: Get application details by UUID (optional field selection).

tool_signatures.name: getDatabase
tool_signatures.description: Get database details by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: getDeployment
tool_signatures.description: Get deployment status and logs by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: getHealth
tool_signatures.description: Check that the Coolify API is up (GET /health).

tool_signatures.name: getInfrastructureOverview
tool_signatures.description: One-call summary of the whole Coolify estate: servers, projects, applications (with status breakdown), databases, services, and currently running deployments.

tool_signatures.name: getLogs
tool_signatures.description: Fetch runtime logs for an application.

tool_signatures.name: getServer
tool_signatures.description: Get server details by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: listAppDeployments
tool_signatures.description: List deployments for an application with pagination (skip/take).

tool_signatures.name: listApplications
tool_signatures.description: List all Coolify applications.

tool_signatures.name: listDatabases
tool_signatures.description: List databases with optional pagination and filters.

tool_signatures.name: listDeployments
tool_signatures.description: List currently running deployments.

tool_signatures.name: listEnvironments
tool_signatures.description: List all environments for a project. Requires the project UUID.

tool_signatures.name: listGithubApps
tool_signatures.description: List all configured GitHub Apps. Used for private repository access.

tool_signatures.name: listPrivateKeys
tool_signatures.description: List all SSH private keys. Keys are used for server authentication and deploy keys.

tool_signatures.name: listProjects
tool_signatures.description: List all Coolify projects. Returns project UUID, name, description, and environments.

tool_signatures.name: listResources
tool_signatures.description: List Coolify resources with optional pagination, summary, and filters.

tool_signatures.name: listServers
tool_signatures.description: List all Coolify servers. Returns server UUID, name, IP, user, port, and proxy type.

tool_signatures.name: listServices
tool_signatures.description: List all Coolify services (one-click apps like databases, caches, etc.).

tool_signatures.name: redeployProject
tool_signatures.description: Trigger a deployment for every application in a project (optionally a single environment). Asks for confirmation on clients that support elicitation.

tool_signatures.name: restartApplication
tool_signatures.description: Restart an application by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: restartProjectApps
tool_signatures.description: Restart every application in a project (optionally a single environment). Asks for confirmation on clients that support elicitation.

environment.description: Environment name or UUID to restrict to

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Environment name or UUID to restrict to

tool_signatures.name: startApplication
tool_signatures.description: Start an application by UUID. Optionally force rebuild.

tool_signatures.name: stopAllApplications
tool_signatures.description: Stop every running application, optionally restricted to one project. Asks for confirmation on clients that support elicitation, stating the blast radius.

tool_signatures.name: stopApplication
tool_signatures.description: Stop an application by UUID.

tool_signatures.name: updateApplication
tool_signatures.description: Update an application

tool_signatures.name: updateDatabase
tool_signatures.description: Update a database

tool_signatures.name: updateProject
tool_signatures.description: Update a project

tool_signatures.name: validateServer
tool_signatures.description: Validate server connection and configuration by UUID.
